# Numerische Lösung

```{julia}
using DotMaps
using CairoMakie
using LinearAlgebra

using MMJMesh.Plots
using MMJMesh.Mathematics
```

## Problemparameter

```{julia}
# Mehrfachvariable
p = DotMap()

# Basiswerte
p.E = 35e9
p.d = 0.8
p.l = 20
p.F = 2e6
p.ρ = 2500
p.g = 9.81
p.S = 120e6
p.c = 1.75e7

# Abgeleitete Werte
p.Ω = 0 .. p.l
p.C = p.c * π * p.d
p.A = π * p.d^2 / 4
p.EA = p.E * p.A
p.n = p.ρ * p.g * p.A;
```

## Exakte Lösung

```{julia}
a1 = 3 + 7π
a2 = 7π - 3
x = parameter(p.Ω)

u = exp(-x / 20) / (3500000 * π * (a1 * ℯ^2 - a2)) * (
        25000 * (a1 * ℯ^2 + a2 * exp(x / 10))
        -
        2943 * π * ℯ * (exp(x / 10) + 1)
        +
        981 * π * exp(x / 20) * (a1 * ℯ^2 - a2)
    )

N = p.EA * u'

fig = Figure()
fplot!(Axis(fig[1, 1], title="Verschiebung u"), u, npoints=100)
fplot!(Axis(fig[2, 1], title="Normalkraft N"), N, npoints=100)
fig
```

## Schwache Form

```{julia}
a(u, δu) = integrate(p.EA * u' * δu' + p.C * u * δu, p.Ω) + p.S * u(p.l) * δu(p.l)
b(δu) = integrate(p.n * δu, p.Ω) + p.F * δu(0)
```
